headline: Binance withdrawals stay paused ahead of a planned phased restart on Sunday, while bitcoin heads for its worst October since 2014.

market.asOf: BTC and ETH from Investing.com at 05:34 UTC Sat 31 Oct (12:34 Bangkok); Fear and Greed for 31 Oct (UTC). Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 30 out of 100 ('Fear') on alternative.me's Crypto Fear and Greed Index, 31 Oct, as shown by Altcoin Buzz.

stories.title: Binance withdrawals still paused; phased restart planned for Sunday
stories.summary: No source found by this edition says withdrawals have restarted or that the planned reserve snapshot has been published. Binance's timeline points to a phased restart around 12:33 Bangkok time on Sunday 1 Nov, after security checks, with Proof of Reserves results (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) due before 2 Nov.
points: Per ChainCatcher, Binance said it would 'gradually restore withdrawal services within approximately 34 hours', which it puts at about 13:33 (UTC+8) on 1 Nov, after a reserve snapshot at about 15:33 (UTC+8) on 31 Oct.
Binance says it has more than $6.34B of company funds ready and has replenished about 80% of the stolen assets, per TechFlow; it is buying the rest through market and OTC deals, per TokenPost.
Binance's Richard Teng promised a full Proof of Reserves report by Monday, per The Defiant; CoinDesk said the next reserve snapshot would be taken on 1 Nov.
CoinDesk says the roughly 204,500 ETH taken is about 5.6% of Binance's ETH reserves, which would drop its ETH backing to near 94% before replacement.

stories.title: Bitcoin heads for a losing October as ETF money flows out
stories.summary: Bitcoin is on track for a monthly loss after a tech-led stock sell-off on Friday, and US spot bitcoin and ether funds saw money leave in the latest reported session.
points: Cointelegraph, citing CoinGlass, said bitcoin was set to close October 7.7% lower, its worst October since 2014.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $643.33M on 30 Oct, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $233.70M, ending a four-session inflow streak, per TokenPost citing SoSoValue.
US spot ether ETFs lost $155.85M on 30 Oct, their fifth straight day of outflows, per TokenPost.
Tech stocks sold off on Friday: the Nasdaq was down 2.5% at about 25,500 at the time of Cointelegraph's report, and Intel dropped nearly 30% at the open.

stories.title: Following the stolen money: the bitcoin hasn't moved, other funds are being laundered
stories.summary: Blockchain trackers give slightly different totals for how much was stolen, frozen and out of reach, so each is named. The 18,270 stolen bitcoin had not been spent, while stablecoins and ether were being moved with laundering patterns analysts say they have not seen before.
points: Amount stolen: Binance says about $6.3B; Elliptic says $6.43B.
Frozen or out of reach: Elliptic has verified $2.84B frozen and says about $3.33B cannot be frozen by issuers; TRM told the New York Times $2.4B has moved beyond any issuer's reach.
CoinDesk says the 18,270 stolen BTC sits in 19 addresses, more than Tesla's 11,509 BTC, and none had been spent as of early Friday ET.
Elliptic says North Korea-linked actors likely did it; asked about North Korea, President Trump said 'We're looking at that', per the New York Times.

briefs.title: CFTC chair cites the hack
briefs.summary: CFTC Chairman Mike Selig said the breach 'proves our exact point' and pushed a federal option for offshore exchanges to register and meet US cybersecurity standards, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Strategy shares fall after results
briefs.summary: Strategy (MSTR) fell about 10% after its Q3 report; it holds a $4.83B cash reserve, per The Block.

briefs.title: Coinbase Q3 revenue falls
briefs.summary: Coinbase reported Q3 revenue of $1.22B, down 35% from a year earlier, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Tether reports $1.5B Q3 profit
briefs.summary: Tether reported a $1.5B Q3 net operating profit, with excess reserves up to $7.95B from about $4.1B, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Liquidations near $1.6B
briefs.summary: Rolling 24-hour liquidations of leveraged bets reached $1.56B, with longs at $1.31B, per Cointelegraph citing CoinGlass.

briefs.title: ICE plans US perpetual futures on Hyperliquid
briefs.summary: ICE and trade[XYZ] plan a regulated US perpetual-futures venue built on Hyperliquid, which needs CFTC approval, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Aave reopens; hack may push traders to DEXs
briefs.summary: Aave unfroze its markets after the exploiter borrowed against stolen USDT, and Standard Chartered's Geoffrey Kendrick said the hack could push trading toward decentralized exchanges, per Cointelegraph.
